summary_en: Six-axle port/shunting workhorse converted to electric: 1650kW wheel power + 2346kWh LiFePO4, saving ~¥5,000/day with volume application record.
description_en: Conversion keeps DF4B outline dimensions basically unchanged: the diesel genset, starting generator, rectifier, exciter, DC traction motors, braking resistor, starting gearbox, preheating boiler and fuel tank are removed; retained frame, wheelsets, coupler & draft and braking system are overhauled per heavy-repair standards (including TB/T1618/1619 axle flaw detection and TB/T1463 wheelset assembly). Car-body underframe mounting is strength-simulated; the power-room modular structure eases replacement and repair. Converted locomotives run stably — port duty record: 380 days, 15,067km, 80% energy saving.

specs_en.改造方式: Diesel genset & auxiliaries removed, replaced by LiFePO4 traction battery (~2346kWh, DC753.8V) + integrated main/aux converter; three-phase AC traction motors replace DC motors
specs_en.结构参数: In-service weight 138t / Co-Co / gauge 1435mm / wheel diameter 1050mm / dimensions 21100×3309×4700mm
specs_en.性能参数: Traction power 1820kW (wheel 1650kW) / starting tractive effort 436kN / continuous 330kN / electric braking 1300kW
specs_en.牵引电机: 6×310kW three-phase asynchronous motors (axle-controlled); a single faulty inverter module loses only 1/6 of power
specs_en.制动系统: JZ-7 air brake with renewed air reservoirs and overhauled piping
specs_en.司机室: Dual cabs + TCMS (computer display) + monitoring display
specs_en.充电方案: Three 400kW dual-gun chargers, 6 guns simultaneously — ~2h for ~2000kWh daily duty
specs_en.经济性: Daily cost cut from ~¥6,249 (fuel) to ~¥1,249.3 (electricity) — saving ~¥4,999.7/day
specs_en.适用场景: Ports / logistics / shunting, long-distance high-frequency heavy haul, max grade 6‰, min. curve 145m, -35℃~+40℃

description_en: Coach reading lights are single-unit auxiliary lighting products mounted above seats or on sidewalls, giving passengers independent local reading light. Compact with soft output, they are widely used in EMU and metro coaches and have been fitted in volume on metro lines in Shenzhen, Chengdu, Guangzhou, Wuhan and Ningbo as well as on low-floor vehicles.

Compact and easy to install and maintain, the series is widely used in metro and EMU coach lighting with volume applications across metro lines.
